error.message: The PIN you used has ended. Enter a new PIN to continue.
Enter a PIN or sign in first.

notes: folder_name is the folder the PIN sends into, null while the server has only one folder. shows_folder: the PIN also shows what is in its folder, so the session may use GET /api/folders, /api/library, /api/files, /api/files/ids, /api/files/{id} with its content and thumbnail, and ZIPs (/api/downloads), all for that folder only; without it they answer 403 forbidden. encrypt is the key new files into an encrypted folder are encrypted for: {"folder", "version", "public_key"}; null while the folder is plain.
